history.summary: IDENTITY FLAG: the only well-documented 'Shree Lakshmi Narasimha Swamy Temple, Davanagere' is the PANCHA DEVASTHANA MAHA KSHETRA temple, known through its active devotional media presence (YouTube channel @PanchaDevasthana, Instagram @panchadevasthana, Facebook PanchaDevasthana) posting daily darshan, abhisheka, alankara and mantra content of Shri Lakshmi Narasimha Swamy at Davanagere. No street address, founding date, or architectural description is published for this temple - only the city (Davanagere) is confirmed, so city-level coordinates are used here and the exact locality is unverified. Do not confuse this shrine with other Narasimha temples in the wider region (e.g. Harapanahalli ~37 km away, Ranibennur, or the Ahobila-affiliated shrine near Davangere). Daily worship with abhisheka and alankara is evident from the channel's darshan posts. CSV town/state (Davangere, Karnataka) are correct as far as can be verified; treat the precise identity as provisional pending local confirmation.
